Class RedisConnectionConfiguration

java.lang.Object
org.apache.beam.sdk.io.redis.RedisConnectionConfiguration
All Implemented Interfaces:

public abstract class RedisConnectionConfiguration extends Object implements Serializable
RedisConnectionConfiguration describes and wraps a connectionConfiguration to Redis server or cluster.
